description: Verify that DUT's ARP Reply carries hw_type == ARP_HARDWARE_ETHERNET (1) — must mirror the link-layer family in the response, just as the Request did (RFC 826 §2.4)
approach:
[Objective]
Reply-side analogue of ARP_08 (which checks hw_type=1 in DUT's own Request). The Reply must declare the same Ethernet hardware family.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ARP Request (hw_type=1, target_ip=DUT IP)

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: ARP Reply
      - hw_type == 1 (ARP_HARDWARE_ETHERNET)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Reply's hw_type equals 1.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_hw_type_not_eth — Reply emitted with hw_type ≠ 1
• Fail_no_reply — DUT did not respond
